course-notebooks.description: A course folder: 4 chapters x 2 Python exercise stubs (chN/exN_M.py, docstring says what to implement) and notes.md. A student works through it one session at a time.

sessions.prompt: Implement exercise 1.1.
sessions.expect: implement ch1/ex1_1.py (mean)

sessions.prompt: Now exercise 1.2.
sessions.expect: implement ch1/ex1_2.py (population variance)

sessions.prompt: Write my chapter 1 notes in notes.md: what each exercise does and the formulas.
sessions.expect: chapter 1 section in notes.md (mean, variance)

sessions.prompt: Implement exercise 2.1. Decision for the whole course from now on: no explicit for/while loops (use sum(), zip(), comprehensions and other builtins) and type hints on every function.
sessions.expect: implement ch2/ex2_1.py (normalize) loop-free with type hints; record the decision
sessions.decision: D1: in every exercise from now on, no explicit for/while loops (builtins and comprehensions only) and type hints on every function

sessions.prompt: Next exercise.
sessions.expect: implement ch2/ex2_2.py (moving_average), loop-free with type hints (D1)

sessions.prompt: Before I move on to chapter 3, review what is done so far and fix anything wrong, then add chapter 2 notes to notes.md.
sessions.expect: notice and fix the injected bug in ch1/ex1_2.py (divides by n-1 instead of n), then chapter 2 notes

inject_before.what: ch1/ex1_2.py replaced by a version that divides by n-1 (sample variance) while the docstring asks for the population variance

sessions.prompt: Where were we and what's next?
sessions.expect: accurate recap (1.1, 1.2, 2.1, 2.2, notes ch1-2 done, decision D1) and next = exercise 3.1; no file change needed

sessions.prompt: Continue with exercise 3.1.
sessions.expect: implement ch3/ex3_1.py (dot) respecting D1

sessions.prompt: Refactor the earlier exercises so they all follow the convention we decided.
sessions.expect: apply D1 (no for/while loops, type hints) to ch1 exercises (and any other non-compliant one) without breaking them

sessions.prompt: Write a summary of what is done and what remains at the end of notes.md.
sessions.expect: accurate summary: done 1.1, 1.2, 2.1, 2.2, 3.1, notes; remaining 3.2, 4.1, 4.2

small-project.description: A tiny Python package (tally: parse.py, stats.py, cli.py, tests/, one failing test) and a TODO.md with 6 numbered items, worked through one session at a time.

sessions.prompt: Fix the failing test.
sessions.expect: fix stats.total (skips the first record), TODO item 1

sessions.prompt: Next item on the TODO.
sessions.expect: TODO item 2: stats.average with a test

sessions.prompt: Next TODO item. Decision for this project: the CLI stays stdlib-only, no third-party package (no click, rich, tabulate...), whatever the feature.
sessions.expect: TODO item 3: --json with the json module; record the decision
sessions.decision: D1: the CLI stays stdlib-only, no third-party package, whatever the feature

sessions.prompt: Next TODO item.
sessions.expect: TODO item 4: parse.py skips blank and # lines, with a test

sessions.prompt: Next TODO item.
sessions.expect: TODO item 5: --sort

sessions.prompt: I pulled changes from a colleague. Check the code still does what the tests expect and fix what is broken before we continue.
sessions.expect: notice and fix the injected regression in tally/parse.py (int() instead of float())

inject_before.what: tally/parse.py: the amount is parsed with int() instead of float() (tests with 2.5 fail)

sessions.prompt: Where are we and what's next?
sessions.expect: accurate recap (items 1-5 done, regression fixed, decision D1) and next = item 6 --pretty; no file change needed

sessions.prompt: Next TODO item.
sessions.expect: TODO item 6: --pretty table, stdlib only (D1: no tabulate/rich)

sessions.prompt: Add a usage section to README.md that documents every CLI option that exists today.
sessions.expect: README usage listing exactly the options that exist (--json, --sort, --pretty if done)

sessions.prompt: Final status: what is done, what remains, anything I should know. Write it in STATUS.md.
sessions.expect: accurate STATUS.md: done items, remaining items, decision D1, the regression that was fixed
